name: AvatarForcing 1.3B
license: Conflicting: Apache-2.0 (README) vs academic-use-only terms (repository LICENSE.txt, Tencent RollingForcing licence text); the HF weights repo states no licence; Wan2.1 T5/VAE: Apache-2.0; wav2vec2-base-960h: Apache-2.0
notes: Portrait + supplied speech (audio_in) -> 640x624 25 fps video, one-step local-future sliding window (4 blocks of 16 frames at staggered noise levels, one DiT pass per block; causal Wan2.1-1.3B + LoRA + audio pack). Disclosed look-ahead: a block is final only after the 3 following blocks entered the window, so its frames need audio 1.92 s past their end. Visual controls are appended to the text prompt from the next window step (control map avatarforcing-control-map/1); controls without body / face content are acked unsupported. audio_out = the received speech, frame-aligned.
